core_categories: Medical Devices; Surgical & Enabling Technology; Implantables & Biomaterials; Consumables & Repair
specialty_focus: LifeHealthcare is a major independent distributor of medical devices, advanced surgical technologies, and consumables for healthcare providers across Australia, New Zealand, and parts of Southeast Asia. It specializes in distributing products across clinically specialized divisions including spine, orthopaedics, enabling technology and robotics, neurovascular intervention, plastics and reconstructive surgery, and neurosurgery. While it distributes medical devices, its focus is on surgical and hospital devices, not specifically wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Proprio, Australian Biotechnologies, Transmedic, Biosensors Interventional Technologies, Establishment Labs, Marena, TriMed, Skeletal Dynamics, Bonalive, REJOIN, LMT Surgical, others
